03 — About Samudhra

Our Story

What begins in tradition becomes something new at the table.

Each dish begins with the traditions, spices, and regional flavors that shape Indian cooking, interpreted through a modern dining experience. The menu brings familiar flavors into a refined setting — rooted in tradition, still fresh, vibrant, and distinctly Samudhra.
